status.description: Final outcome of the test after all retries. Send one record per test.

retry.description: Retries used before the final outcome. passed with retry > 0 means flaky (failed, then passed); failed with retry > 0 means it failed on every attempt.

error.description: For a failed test, the final error; for a flaky pass, the error of the first failed attempt.
